Pages of a PDF are shown in the window with [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js)
(Mozilla), licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It is included
unmodified, as the files `pdf.min.mjs` and `pdf.worker.min.mjs`, together with
three WebAssembly decoders it uses for particular kinds of picture inside a
PDF -- fax-compressed and JBIG2 (built from code of the PDFium project and
Mozilla), JPEG 2000 (OpenJPEG), and colour conversion (qcms). Their licences
follow.
